records.name: Fort Frances Lookout Tower
records.agency: Municipality of Fort Frances (tourist attraction since 1972)

extra.status_note: Relocated to Fort Frances in 1972 and again in 2009 (HMDB marker; NHLR).
extra.access_text: Public tourist attraction on the La Verendrye Parkway by the Rainy River; moved to this site in 2009.
extra.scope_flag: BORDERLINE: the Fort Frances marker says it was built as an RCAF Pine Tree Line radar gap-filler tower at Pal Lake near Atikokan (project cancelled 1964), sold to Lands and Forests in 1964, and "may have" served briefly as a fire lookout; NHLR/FFLOS register it as a lookout and say 1930s (the marker contradicts that). Owner to decide.

records.name: Fort Frances Lookout Tower Original Site

extra.status_note: Tower moved away 1972. FFLOS gives Kenora District and these coordinates; the HMDB marker says Pal Lake "near Atikokan" (Rainy River District, about 140 km east): check the position.

records.name: Ignace Fire Tower (relocated Bonheur Tower)
records.agency: Ontario Department of Lands and Forests (to 1972), then Ministry of Natural Resources

aliases: History of the Fire Tower marker
extra.status_note: Used until 1969 at the original site (HMDB marker); dismantled and rebuilt here in 1991.
extra.access_text: Exhibit on the south side of the Ignace Public Library (36 Main Street); re-erected 1991 at 66 ft (was 80 ft). Original Bonheur Tower site is 25 km east of Ignace and is held by firelookout.ca as "Bonhuer Fire Tower" (id 11483) with a pin that matches neither place.
